description: The plot illustrates how evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) varies with the activated parameters ratio for four model variants. The x-axis is labeled “Activated Parameters Ratio(%)” on a linear scale, spanning from 100% down to 25% with tick marks at 100, 75, 50, and 25 (decreasing left to right). The y-axis is labeled “Eval PPL” on a linear scale, ranging approximately from 11.0 to 14.5 with regularly spaced ticks every 0.5. A red dashed horizontal line labeled “Transformer” stays constant at about 11.6 across all x-values. The “Only MoHD FFN” series is shown as a gray line with square markers; it is around 11.3 at 100%, about 11.5 at 75%, dips to roughly 11.3 at 50%, then rises to about 11.8 at 25%. The “Only MoHD ATTN” series is a dark line with circular markers; it is about 11.3 at 100%, about 11.5 at 75%, increases to roughly 12.2 at 50%, and then rises sharply to around 14.4 at 25%. The “MoHD ATTN + MLP” series is a blue line with x-shaped markers; it is about 11.3 at 100%, about 11.5 at 75%, increases to roughly 12.0 at 50%, and then increases further to about 13.2 at 25%.
